The '''2017–18 Oklahoma Sooners basketball team''' represented the [[University of Oklahoma]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by seventh-year head coach Lon Kruger and played their home games at the [[Lloyd Noble Center]] in [[Norman, Oklahoma|Norman]], [[Oklahoma]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 18–14, 8–10 in Big 12 play to finish in a tie for eighth place. They lost in the First Round of the [[2018 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2017–18 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the First Round to [[2017–18 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]].

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Sooners]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] with an overall record of 11–20, 5–13 in [[2016–17 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in ninth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2017 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2016–17 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]].
